title: Chapter 2: System Diagnostics
description: Day 6-10 on Syntax-IV. With basic communication established, PROTO-7 learns to configure test suites using the Settings section, create reusable keywords, and handle complex control flow.

story.introduction:
Day 6. Basic systems are online, but MENTOR-9 needs more sophisticated diagnostics.

"PROTO-7, we need to organize our tests better. Learn the Settings section - it's the control panel for your test suites."

"Then we'll build custom diagnostic procedures using Keywords, and add smart decision-making with IF statements."
story.arc: Configure test suites → Create reusable keywords → Add conditional logic → Master loops
story.conclusion: With Settings mastered, custom keywords created, and control flow in place, you can now build sophisticated diagnostic routines.

sections.name: Section 2.1: Settings Section
sections.story: Configure test suites with Settings: hooks, tags, timeouts, libraries.
sections.learningFocus: *** Settings ***, Suite/Test Setup/Teardown, Default Tags, Test Timeout, Library imports

sections.name: Section 2.2: Custom Keywords
sections.story: Build reusable diagnostic procedures using custom keywords.
sections.learningFocus: *** Keywords ***, keyword arguments, return values, keyword documentation

sections.name: Section 2.3: Control Flow - IF Statements
sections.story: Add decision-making to tests with IF/ELSE/ELSE IF logic.
sections.learningFocus: IF conditions, ELSE, ELSE IF, comparison operators, boolean logic

sections.name: Section 2.4: Control Flow - Loops
sections.story: Automate repetitive tasks using FOR loops.
sections.learningFocus: FOR loops, IN RANGE, iterating lists, loop variables, nested loops

learningObjectives: Configure test suites using the *** Settings *** section
Implement Suite Setup/Teardown and Test Setup/Teardown hooks
Apply Default Tags and Test Timeout settings
Import and use built-in libraries (Collections, String, DateTime)
Create custom keywords with arguments and return values
Use IF/ELSE/ELSE IF for conditional logic
keyTakeaways: Settings section configures suite-level behavior (hooks, tags, timeout, libraries)
Suite hooks run ONCE per suite, Test hooks run BEFORE/AFTER EACH test
Custom keywords promote code reuse and readability
IF statements enable conditional execution based on runtime conditions
FOR loops automate repetitive tasks and data-driven testing
Proper organization separates configuration, reusable logic, and test cases

chapterChallenge.title: Advanced Diagnostic Framework
chapterChallenge.description: Create a complete diagnostic suite with Settings configuration, custom keywords, conditional logic, and loops.
